title: Corner Cage
setup: The black king is cornered on a8 with your king one knight-hop away, guarding both escape squares.
hint: Your king already owns a7 and b7. One queen move takes everything else.
explanation:
## The Idea

A cornered king needs only its rank taken away. Your king on b6 covers a7 and b7.

{{Qg8#}} checks from the far side of the board, b8 is on the queen's line, and nothing can block.

Against a cornered king, your own king seals the squares beside it and any check along the back rank is mate.
